name: Dark Souls 1 Knights Honour weapon tracker

mentions.name: Dark Souls 1 Knights Honour weapon tracker
mentions.description: A tool that tells Dark Souls 1 players which weapons they are still missing to earn the Steam Knights Honour achievement. It parses the game's binary save file and extracts the relevant information; the author originally wrote it a few years ago and has revived it to solve a personal need.
mentions.problem: Knowing which weapons are still missing for the Dark Souls 1 Knights Honour achievement previously required manually parsing the game's binary save file through trial and error.
mentions.audience: Dark Souls 1 players working toward the Knights Honour achievement on Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A few years ago I wrote a tool to tell you what weapons in Dark Souls 1 you are missing to get the Knights Honour achievement on steam.

Part of this required that I manually parse a binary save file and extract the information.
